name: 学习工作区（Learning Site）
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which default)"):$PATH"; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build

terminals.name: dev-server
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which default)"):$PATH"; make serve
